name: 七岁养伤的一年

roles.name: Claude娘
roles.voice: young female, soft and playful timbre, mid-high register, intimate gentle pace with a teasing lift

look: 干净利落的二维动画风格，明亮通透的色彩，简洁的线条与平涂阴影，略带纪实感的构图。
setting: 正午的客厅：窗外是正午的强烈日光，明亮的自然光从宽窗涌进室内，整个画面明亮通透。一个人坐在室内正对镜头说话，讲述者位于画面中间。环境中任何可见文字都是中文。
constraints: 全片一个生成片段，机位固定在讲述者正前方，讲述者始终居中正对镜头，姿态放松不挪位；画面里只有讲述者一个人，观众不出现。讲述者按顺序报出从三岁到八岁的经历，每句独立成拍，语速平稳、语气笃定，不重复也不补充。报岁数时只用一只手在胸前做点数的示意动作，另一只手安静放在腿上；说到八岁之后先停一拍、表情收住目光垂下，再给出最后两句，最后一句说完不再加话。角色全程只有讲述者一人，叙述里提到的提问者不出镜、不出声。画面中只有这一名角色，环境中任何可见文字都是中文。
source_script:
角色1动作：他抬起一只手，掰着手指头数数。
角色1：我三岁从文。
角色1：四岁习武。
角色1：五岁精通诗词歌赋。
角色1：六岁就能胸口碎大石。
角色1：八岁通晓琴棋书画。
角色1动作：他停下数数，笑容慢慢收住，目光微微垂下。
角色1：有人问我，你七岁干嘛去了？
角色1动作：他抬起头看向镜头，摊开一只手。
角色1：七岁，养了一年的伤。

events.text: 他抬起一只手，掰着手指头数数。
他停下数数，笑容慢慢收住，目光微微垂下。
有人问我，你七岁干嘛去了？
他抬起头看向镜头，摊开一只手。

execution.look: A clean two-dimensional animation style with bright translucent color, simple linework and flat cel shading, in a lightly documentary composition.
execution.setting: A living room in the midday sun. Strong noon sunlight pours in through the wide window, keeping the whole room bright and clear. Character 1 is the only person in the room, sitting in the middle of frame and talking straight to the camera. Every legible text in the room is in Chinese.
execution.visible_state: Bright midday light fills the room: strong noon sunlight pours through the wide window, keeping the whole frame bright and clear. Character 1 sits facing the camera in the middle of frame with a relaxed matter-of-fact expression, both hands resting open and empty on the knees.

voices.character_1: young female, soft and playful timbre, mid-high register, intimate gentle pace with a teasing lift

directions.event_001: Character 1 raises one hand in front of the chest and moves it in a small counting motion while naming the years, with a slightly proud, matter-of-fact expression, the other hand resting quietly on the knee.
directions.event_007: Character 1 lets the counting hand drop, the smile fading into a brief thoughtful pause with the gaze dipping slightly.
directions.event_009: Character 1 looks back up at the camera and shrugs the shoulders once with one open palm, keeping the delivery flat and deadpan.
